title: Scratch declaration for H5's calibration after reserve-management purchases began (#845; avenue #835)
status: exploration on development data; nothing here is a verdict under scoring protocol v1 (#640). Declared by the pull request that closes #845 before any number was computed. No model is fitted or changed, no remedy is added, nothing is published, and no published declaration, record or pin moves
hypothesis: H5 (primary goal): the SOFR - IORB spread distribution in bp. Step 3 (evaluation: calibration in the regime where the confirmation days fall)

rulings.710: Eleonora, 13 October 2026, on PR #710: a separate scratch declaration for runs that read the 2026 development days; the 3-pressure-day minimum per period cell stays. This file is that declaration for #845; it follows metadata/exploration_684.json

cells.unit: a cell is a (target day, lead h) pair: the lead-h law made h business days before the target day, from the information public then
cells.target_days: two sets of ordinary target days, both reported in full. 'ordinary' (the headline): SplitDeclaration.reporting_day_type(target) == 'ordinary' (metadata/evaluation_splits.json), the type the pressure-day split of #686 and #634 calls ordinary. 'calm_ordinary' (a sensitivity): an ordinary day that also settles no coupon (treasury_settlement_coupons == 0), the 'not a risk day' reading of repo_model.spread_mr_variants.is_risk_day and of #761's contexts, which is the reading the audit of #835 quoted its cell counts under. Added to this declaration after a check of the mean-reversion law on both sets, before any other number; each set has its own cells and its own minimum of pressure days
cells.stretch_membership: by the target day, not the decision day
cells.common_cells: a cell is read only if every law has a forecast for it, so every law is compared on the same cells; a missing law is counted, not filled
cells.decision_days: as in #686 and #634, a decision day is forecast only if its fifth target day is on or before the last day; so the last days before the end are read at the leads that reach them from earlier decision days only
cells.event: the realised spread is above +5 bp as data.exceeds_bp reads it (the whole-basis-point event); a cell with the event is a pressure-day cell, and its target day a pressure day

per_stretch_and_lead: pressure days (distinct target days with the event)
report.p_from_law: smr.exceedance(23 quantiles, 5.0), the curve of ml.exceedance_from_quantiles; never a fitted classifier (the +5 bp classification variants are paused)

interval.kind: 90% percentile interval (5th and 95th) of the stationary bootstrap (Politis-Romano) over the stretch's cells of one lead, in target-day order
applies_to: mean P minus realised share (resampled jointly)

decomposition.applies_to: every law that has a 23-quantile distribution (not persistence_logistic)
decomposition.definition: error = mean P - realised share, per stretch and lead. delta = mean over the cells of (realised spread - the law's median): the law's mean location error on those cells, in bp. P_centred = the mean over the same cells of smr.exceedance(the law's quantiles + delta, 5.0): the same law with its centre moved, its shape (the residual pool) unchanged. Level part = mean P - P_centred. Residual-pool part = P_centred - realised share. The two parts add to the error exactly
decomposition.reading: the level part is the over-warning that a correct centre would remove; the residual-pool part is what remains with the centre correct: the pool is too wide in the upper tail for the regime. delta uses the realised outcomes of the stretch, so it is a hindsight diagnostic of where the error sits, never a forecast and never a remedy
decomposition.also_reported: the mean law median and the mean realised spread (bp), and delta, by lead

ruling_710_cells.rule: event-based figures follow the minimum of 3 pressure days per cell of (stretch, lead). Calibration in the large needs no events, but whether it may be reported for a cell under that minimum is Eleonora's. A (stretch, lead) cell with fewer than 3 pressure days therefore has only its counts (cells, pressure days) in every tracked file and on the results page. Its mean P, realised share, decomposition and interval are computed, written to a file that is not tracked, and put in the pull request body as a marked question
ruling_710_cells.same_for_all_laws: the events depend on the outcomes alone, so the cells under the minimum are the same for every law

not_done: no remedy: a residual pool conditioned on the as-of policy register would be a later, separately declared variant
no registration, no verdict, no comparison with a benchmark's score: this is calibration in the large of the existing laws
no day after 2026-09-03 and no locked day is read
the March 2020 onward days are not read for the earlier case (QE confounds them)
commands: scripts/calibration_reserve_mgmt_845.py walk (the two #634 laws, to the last day)
scripts/calibration_reserve_mgmt_845.py exceedance (persistence_logistic, to the last day)
